verdict.rationale: Browserbase's marketing page documents a fetch capability that converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, and the Skills docs mention fetching pages, so the product itself offers URL-to-HTML retrieval. The evidence does not show this as one API call returning raw HTML. missing for 10: documented single-endpoint API reference for the fetch call, explicit confirmation that the output is raw (unprocessed) HTML, request/response details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scrape a web page with a single API call and get its raw HTML back

citations.quote: Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
how to browse and interact with the web, fetch pages, and manage browser infrastructure
